firm_data.firm_description: Lazarus Karp Ehrlich McCourt, LLP provides legal representation in areas of landlord-tenant practice, commercial and residential leasing, cooperative and condominium matters, rent regulations, administrative law, and general litigation. They also handle real estate transactions.
notable_facts: Chad Karp has been featured on ABC Eyewitness News discussing New York City Housing Court and landlord-tenant issues.
Robert Ehrlich was appointed to the NYC Rent Guidelines Board.

email.subject: AI for Lazarus Karp Ehrlich McCourt, LLP - built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Chad,

Your recent appearance on ABC Eyewitness News discussing NYC Housing Court caught my attention, especially given how Housing Court demands have intensified for landlord-tenant practices. We're seeing the same pressure across firms handling residential leasing and cooperative matters in New York.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms facing BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now meeting regional firms to show how ex-lawyers like us are helping practices compete with larger competitors. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share a brief demo tailored to landlord-tenant workflows.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
